start_gcode.label: Start Gcode
start_gcode.description: G-code prepended to every generated job.
start_gcode.default_value:
;----------- Start Gcode -----------
M2000 ;custom:line mode
M888 P0 ;custom:header is write&draw
;-----------------------------------

end_gcode.label: End Gcode
end_gcode.description: G-code appended to every generated job.

transformation.label: Transformation
transformation.description: Position, size, and orientation of the model on the bed.

width.label: Width
width.description: Width of the model on the bed (mm).

height.label: Height
height.description: Height of the model on the bed (mm).

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotation of the model around its centre (degrees, counter-clockwise).

x.label: Move X
x.description: Horizontal position of the model centre (mm).

y.label: Move Y
y.description: Vertical position of the model centre (mm).

flip_model.label: Flip Model
flip_model.description: Mirror the model along an axis, or none.

invert.label: Invert
invert.description: Swap black and white before processing.

bw.label: Threshold
bw.description: Pixels darker than this value are treated as black (0–255).

line_direction.label: Line Direction
line_direction.description: Direction of the parallel fill lines.

working_parameters.label: Working Parameters
working_parameters.description: Speed, power, and pass settings used during the job.
